title: ログアウトできない僕らの星図
author: 綾瀬 ナノ

en.title: The Star Chart of Us Who Cannot Log Out
en.premise: In an era where memories can be digitized and stored, a boy named Haru wanders into a forgotten server via a legacy VR device. There, he meets Sora, an incomplete AI girl generated from his own childhood memories. To save her from deletion, the two embark on a journey to collect the 'star chart' of fragmented memories.

zh.title: 无法登出的我们的星图
zh.premise: 在一个能将记忆数据化并保存的时代，少年晴透过旧世代的VR设备，误入了一个被遗忘的服务器。在那里他遇见的，是由他童年记忆生成的不完全AI少女空。为了拯救注定将被消除的她，两人踏上了收集碎片化记忆“星图”的旅程。
